summary: Recent updates to the WebCodecs area of Firefox have focused on improving the robustness and usability of video processing features. A notable enhancement is the fix for handling errors in the `ImageDecoder`, which now propagates a proper exception if an `ArrayBuffer` transfer fails, replacing the previous behavior of storing an incorrect pointer. Additionally, the renaming of `CopyTo` to `CopyPlaneInto` clarifies the function’s purpose when manipulating video frames, while optimizing cropping behavior ensures only the visible part of an RGBA-backed `VideoFrame` is swizzled. Together, these changes enhance the stability and clarity of video data handling, which is critical for applications relying on smooth video playback and manipulation. **This matters because it contributes to more reliable video experiences on the web, essential for everything from streaming services to real-time communications.**
